title: Classify the trap
prompt: The code in `classify` computes with TWO planted weaknesses. Decide what a trace shows, then classify the DOMINANT family via the return value using the mapping in the comments. (This is the taxonomy, practiced.)

tests.name: family identified
tests.code:
CjTestBase.checkEq(Solution.classify(3), 8, "loop runs n+1 times: 4 * 2");
CjTestBase.checkEq(Solution.classify(0), 2, "the <= bite at n = 0");
tests.hint: 100/50 = 2 (integer division), but the loop is off-by-one (<= n).
